title: No. 5 (Authenticated)
summary: A browser drips a random Pollock, then certifies its own noise as authentic with the debunked fractal test built to catch forgers.
mechanism: Canvas per-visit drip painting whose own ImageData is read back and box-counted client-side for fractal dimension D, self-issuing a certificate that always passes.
references: Richard P. Taylor, R. Micolich & D. Jonas, fractal analysis of Pollock (Nature, 1999)
